prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Sony 52' BRAVIA XBR Series Black LCD Flat Panel HDTV - KDL52XBR6; brand: sony; description: Sony 52' BRAVIA XBR Series Black LCD Flat Panel HDTV - KDL52XBR6/ 1920 x 1080 Full HD 1080p Resolution/ Digital Media Extender (DMex)/ BRAVIA Engine II Technology/ Advanced Contrast Enhancer (ACE)/ 24p True Cinema/ 120Hz Refresh Rate With Dejudder Processing/ Bottom-Mounted Speaker/ Black Finish

Candidates:
1. name: Sony BRAVIA XBR Series KDL-46XBR6 46' LCD TV - KDL46XBR6; brand: Sony; description: 46' - Active Matrix TFT - ATSC, NTSC - 16:9 - 1920 x 1080 - Dolby, Surround - HDTV - 480i, 480p, 720p, 1080i, 1080p; price: $1,977.72
2. name: Sony BRAVIA V Series KDL-52V4100 52' LCD TV - KDL52V4100; brand: Sony; description: 52' - ATSC, NTSC - 16:9 - 1920 x 1080 - HDTV; price: $1,599.00
3. name: Sony BRAVIA XBR Series KDL-37XBR6 37' LCD TV - KDL37XBR6; brand: Sony; description: 37' - Active Matrix TFT - ATSC, NTSC, NTSC-M - 16:9 - 1920 x 1080 - Surround - HDTV - 1080i, 1080p; price: $1,197.66

response.text: {"reason": "The model number KDL52XBR6 in the price-list item matches the KDL-52XBR6 in candidate 1, ignoring case and spaces.", "choice": 1, "confidence": 0.9}
